summary: #1480: person-root fingerprint pinning for device pairing

replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged person-root fingerprint pinning for device pairing change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in person-root fingerprint pinning for device pairing; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: CLI, stui and phone pairing completion now require a trusted person-root fingerprint or an explicit warned unpinned override. Existing saved pairings continue to work; old clients may ignore the new optional response fields. New pinned messaging pairing can work with older members, but pinned read-only pairing requires a member that returns the added signed root proof; upgrade that member first.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by person-root fingerprint pinning for device pairing; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: For a new pairing or re-pair, copy the full person-root fingerprint separately from the trusted machine and supply it through the client fingerprint field or --fingerprint. Never obtain the trust pin from the completing gateway. Existing profiles need no conversion or forced re-pair. Missing trust input is refused before submitting the pairing code; --unpinned is an explicit security-reducing override, not an automatic upgrade repair.

recovery.detail: Failed re-pair verification preserves the existing saved profile and signing key. Retry with the independently trusted fingerprint and an upgraded member where pinned read-only pairing needs the new root proof. No graph repair is required; preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow roll-forward guidance.
